title: Why Instant Payments Are Becoming Table Stakes for Businesses
summary: How do you issue payouts faster and more efficiently? How do you onboard customers faster so they can start using your payment products now? Discover new methods available now that include card rails, and bank rails like FedNow and Real-Time Payments (RTP). In our Linkedin Live audio event, we navigate the nuances of instant payments, shedding light on new payment systems and the revenue potential of successful adoption. Industry leaders Gil Akos, CEO of Astra, and Kyle Costello, Senior Manager, Partnerships at Treasury Prime offer their expertise in this fascinating interactive conversation.
